customerOutcome: Distinguish automatic steps, Human checkpoints, execution-owner review and unavailable steps under the Original governance policy.
entryConditions: Resolve the current Original account, company and per-operation Native authority. Profile/navigation is not a grant.
Effective rollout and current-source requirements remain independent; suppress private state during uncertain account or source checks.
exitConditions: Only the Original server-confirmed result permits a completion claim.
Keep stale, unknown, refused and unqualified outcomes distinct; preserve the exact original request for recovery.

content.supportingCopy: Distinguish automatic steps, Human checkpoints, execution-owner review and unavailable steps under the Original governance policy.
displayedState: Human checkpoint, no checkpoint, execution-owner review or unavailable semantics for each step.
Current checkpoint summary and consequence; no checkpoint never overrides execution admission.
A draft checkpoint does not create or pre-approve a future material action.

The ordinary run exposes exact active Native tool and Human checkpoint reviews. Human decisions bind the current approval material; a changed binding refuses before effect. Approval does not verify subsequent execution.

primary.label: Review step policy
primary.operation: Inspect or explicitly edit the current draft through its existing versioned owner. Resolve actual pending governed work only through its Original current approval resolver.

secondary: Open the current Original object or its existing full resolver.
Refresh current authority/source and recover an unknown Original request.
destructiveOrIrreversible: Any consequential operation requires its separate current Native review/version/permission boundary; no implicit acknowledgement.

canonicalReadDomains: Original workflow revision/node semantics and registered operation availability
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: Original draft editing can save checkpoint configuration. Only the existing Native approval/decision owner settles an actual governed action; presentation and publication confer no approval.
systemWork.authorityEffect: No new authority, execution, provider access, approval or physical-erasure claim. Existing domain owners retain every material effect.
systemWork.asyncWork: Existing domain-specific bounded reads/commands only. Withdraw stale private state and recover the Original request after an unknown answer.
systemWork.receipt: The exact current Native object/version/request receipt when that owner confirms it; observation and provider consent are not effect receipts.

states.loading: Announce loading only while the current identity/company request is pending.
states.empty: Explain an actual empty authorized result. Missing dependencies or qualified capabilities are separate unavailable states.
states.partial: Retain trustworthy available results and name unavailable dependencies or sources.
states.stale: Remove executable actions and refresh canonical state; preserved input is not evidence of current authority.
states.validation_error: Preserve other entered values, identify the field problem and associate it programmatically with the control.
states.system_error: Explain that the operation is unconfirmed, preserve entered data, and offer a valid retry/refresh or support route.
states.permission_denied: Suppress retained private data and unavailable controls; do not infer additional grants from profile or navigation.
states.recovering: Re-resolve canonical state/version and the original request identity before permitting another effect.
states.success: Announce only the server-confirmed canonical result. First value additionally requires independently verified native artifact/run binding.

navigation.back: Use the existing scoped route and preserve same-principal unsent input in memory through account checks.
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: Cancel performs no new effect. Explicit saved drafts remain in the Original draft owner; private input is not added to browser persistence.
navigation.resume: Resolve the current principal/company/source again and use the Original object or request identity; never reconstruct a grant or replay automatically.

accessibility.initialFocus: Main heading or the dialog category control; keyboard focus is visible and unobscured.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Error summary or first invalid control, with a programmatically associated explanation.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: Canonical receipt or next-step heading; announcements do not trap focus.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Standard buttons, links, labeled text inputs and semantic single-select controls; dialog Escape/close and focus return use the native primitive.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Use status for pending/success and alert for material failures, without repeated routine interruption.
accessibility.targetSize: Custom frequent and primary controls target at least 44 × 44 CSS px.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Require browser/manual verification at 200% and 400% zoom and narrow mobile width; this file is not proof of conformance.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No essential animated transition or moving progress indicator.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: One meaningful H1, persistent visible labels, named sections and logical DOM/focus order.

responsive.wide: Readable constrained content width with natural wrapping.
responsive.narrow: Reflow cards and form actions without concealing utilities or consequences.
responsive.mobile: Touch targets remain reachable; dialogs scroll within the viewport and do not obscure focus.

dataShown: Current principal/company/resource-authorized Native state and bounded review metadata only
dataCollected: Explicit Human fields only under the Original owner processing purpose; leaf editors retain their own field contracts

Before an explicit decision, sessionStorage retains only the opaque Original request ID, approve/reject choice and one-day local validity. Its key scopes company, current principal, run and opaque attempt ID. No review prose, inputs or outputs are persisted. A lost reply remains locked across refresh, remount and reload; reads never replay the decision.
sensitiveFields: Private configuration, work, account/source references and provider credentials
privacySecurity.loggingConstraints: Exclude private prose, configuration, raw credentials, provider responses and raw errors from generic logs/analytics. Preserve existing purpose-bound Native audit and credential handling.

functional: Verify the specified Native baseline/version, current actor, no implicit effect, exact replay and lost-response recovery on the exact artifact.

Current run pointers, exact Human material and node/revision binding, current-account refusal, unknown decision recovery and Native compare-and-set are covered by scoped software tests. Independent full card-family, channel and representative Human qualification remain open.
accessibility: Verify keyboard/focus/announcements and 200/400% zoom manually on the exact artifact.
securityPrivacy: Verify current-account/resource revocation, tenant isolation, refusal before effect, exact source/version and only the declared opaque recovery locator in browser persistence. Exclude private review prose and raw errors from generic logs.
This contract maps existing partial Native implementation and intended V3 behavior. It accepts no release evidence by itself.
usability: Use representative exploratory and pre-registered confirmatory journey evidence with explicit PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; source checks are insufficient.
